verdict.rationale: IRS pages publish the gating steps up front. Online Account sign-in requires ID.me with selfie/video/biometric verification, and signed mobile-friendly forms such as Form 15620 require that account. The EIN assistant states its operating hours, one-EIN-per-day limit, 15-minute no-save session, and third-party designee authorization. E-file provider enrollment lists fingerprinting and up to 45 days for approval, and IRIS A2A states it requires a Transmitter Control Code. The 403 probe on the online 15620 entry matches the published sign-in requirement. Missing for 10: a single consolidated pre-flight checklist per filing path, specifics of which documents ID.me proofing demands, and independent hands-on confirmation that no unpublished steps surface mid-flow.
